items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: During the New Lowdown, that's a tune from Black Boy. Yeah, I remember that tune.

ctx.x: See, now he made East St. Louis Tudeloo and Birmingham Breakdown, Fort Brunswick, February 28, 1927. I remember that. That's why I can tell you. Yeah, that would be after you could join the band. Did you ever make New Orleans Lowdown and Song of the Cotton Feet? I remember them by that name.
I remember the, during the New Lowdown, but not the New Orleans Lowdown. Yeah. During the New Lowdown, that's a tune from Black Boy. Yeah, I remember that tune.
I've got a good record at home. I wish I had to hear them. Immigration Blues of the Creeper. Yeah.
